primitives.verbatim_quote: # NEXT-057: Incident signal and alert map ## Repo(s) SigNoz, Novu ## Category Reliability ## Goal Implement or design the incident signal and alert map capability for GSE / GSN without touching production data first.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S(t)': 'Signal strength at time t (dimensionless)', 'T_{alert}': 'Alert threshold (dimensionless)', 'F(t)': 'Failure indicator function (boolean)'}

primitives.name: Reliability Upgrade
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## GSE / GSN Fit Fits the website and operating-system layer as a reliability upgrade.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'R(t)': 'System reliability at time t (probability)', 'U(t)': 'Utilization rate (dimensionless)', 'D(t)': 'Down-time duration (time)'}

primitives.breakdown_regime: When R(t) < threshold due to excessive D(t) or low U(t).

Observability enhancement builds upon this by quantifying system transparency, which directly impacts autonomous decision-making. The reliability upgrade integrates both into a cohesive framework where system integrity is maintained through continuous monitoring and adaptive response. These primitives form a dual structure: one for detecting anomalies (signal detection), another for interpreting their implications (observability), with the third ensuring operational resilience (reliability). Each primitive operates under probabilistic assumptions and has defined failure regimes that trigger corrective actions. The interplay between these three creates a feedback loop where enhanced observability informs better signal detection, which in turn supports more robust reliability mechanisms.
